name: latest_complete_month_totals
purpose: Show the headline performance for the latest complete month with the core revenue, units, transactions, price, basket size and basket value measures.
intent: Grand totals for [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], filtered to 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[DOC_MONTH] = 12 and with matching month context propagated through the active KEY relationships to CAT_TRANSACTIONS, one row. This is the report headline period because the model is monthly and the latest complete month is month 12.
dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW(
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "bills growth", [bills growth],
        "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
        "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
        "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
        "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
    ),
    TREATAS ( { 12 }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[DOC_MONTH] ),
    TREATAS ( { 12 }, 'CAT_TABLE'[DOC_MONTH] ),
    TREATAS ( { 12 }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[DOC_MONTH] )
)

TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(

        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %]
    ),
    [net revenue CURRENT], DESC
)
